# DeerFlow project instructions

Use [the repository AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md) as the shared repository guide.
Then read [the cross-platform onboarding entry](../docs/ai/README.md) and
[the current task pointer](../docs/ai/CURRENT_TASK.md), followed by the applicable
module guide named in AGENTS.md.

Do not assume this platform inherits another assistant's chat history, permissions,
subagents, skills or local execution state. Confirm the actual checkout, user's
current task and available tools before acting. Reading the guide is not an
instruction to resume paused implementation or run services.

Commands and dependency requirements come from the current Makefiles, package
manifests and lockfiles. Acceptance claims must refer to the exact tested source
and original receipts. Historical counts, cached PASS results and configuration
examples are not current validation. Do not bypass environment validation or omit
gates to reproduce an older report.

This file is an entry pointer, not a second copy of project policy or task status.
